description: Ministry  of Transport & Civil Aviation - Regulations made to repeal of the Regulation 2(1) of the Motor Traffic (Reward and Incentive Fund) Regulations No. 04 of 2011 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1726/12 of 05.10.2011 and for substitution
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport under the Motor Traffic Act, specifically amending existing regulations regarding the management and administration of the Reward and Incentive Fund. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters (amendments to regulations under an Act) rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
